name: document example restores complete breadcrumbs
test:
md = '# header 1
paragraph 1
## header 2
paragraph 2
paragraph 3
# header 3
paragraph 4'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 40)
assert chunks == ['# header 1
paragraph 1', '# header 1
## header 2
paragraph 2', '# header 1
## header 2
paragraph 3', '# header 3
paragraph 4']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 40 for chunk in chunks)

name: same section packs greedily at the exact byte limit
test:
md = '# A
one
two
three'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 11)
assert chunks == ['# A
one
two', '# A
three']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 11 for chunk in chunks)

name: child and sibling sections reuse their common parent
test:
md = '# Guide
intro
## Install
setup
## Usage
run'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 100)
assert chunks == ['# Guide
intro
## Install
setup
## Usage
run']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 100 for chunk in chunks)

name: sibling and root changes discard stale heading context
input:
markdown = '# A
## B
### C
first body
## D
second body
# E
third body', max_size = 25
test:
md = '# A
## B
### C
first body
## D
second body
# E
third body'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 25)
assert chunks == ['# A
## B
### C
first body', '# A
## D
second body', '# E
third body']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 25 for chunk in chunks)

name: skipped heading levels still preserve the active parent
test:
md = '# A
### C
one
## B
two'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 14)
assert chunks == ['# A
### C
one', '# A
## B
two']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 14 for chunk in chunks)

name: UTF-8 budget counts multibyte text and separators
test:
md = '# 文
你好
世界
🙂'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 17)
assert chunks == ['# 文
你好', '# 文
世界
🙂']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 17 for chunk in chunks)

name: blank lines and surrounding whitespace are normalized
input:
markdown = '  # Guide  

  first line  
 
 second line 
', max_size = 100
test:
md = '  # Guide  

  first line  
 
 second line 
'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 100)
assert chunks == ['# Guide
first line
second line']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 100 for chunk in chunks)

name: body before the first heading has no synthetic context
test:
md = 'intro
more
# A
body'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 10)
assert chunks == ['intro
more', '# A
body']
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 10 for chunk in chunks)

name: no body produces no chunks
test:
md = '# Guide\n\n## Empty'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 100)
assert chunks == []
assert all(len(chunk.encode("utf-8")) <= 100 for chunk in chunks)
assert chunk_markdown("", 100) == []
